fields.finding: Load-only F/crush sizing omits possible existing p/2 compression and does not address pull/oblique mooring transfer.
fields.proposed_fix: Determine actual reaction direction and superpose compatible pressure loads; use available compression headroom when applicable, then check face bending, core shear, peel, local shell failure and hardware.

claim: Load-only F/crush sizing omits possible existing p/2 compression and does not address pull/oblique mooring transfer.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
